name: GMI Cloud
description: H100/H200 inference host with two permanently free model endpoints.
overview: GMI Cloud runs open models on H100 and H200 capacity behind an OpenAI-compatible API. Two endpoints are free with no card and no time limit — Llama 3.3 70B Instruct Turbo and DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 70B — served on the same production infrastructure as paid traffic, with 30-plus other models metered. Adding a payment method also drops a $5 credit, but that is a separate offer from the free endpoints.
